notes: Most old references are active source frames, not orphans. Replacing the entire named attack family indiscriminately would overwrite valid pose files: lowKick.png and airLowKick.png already match the canonical outfit, and some inline aliases in frostArc/super are already canonical.

The declared kaname_ascended form recolors aura and energy only; no declared costume or character/sprite-set swap explains the older short navy/cyan outfit. The awakened form introduces moves but no body swap.

The report currently marks 12 mixed/legacy special and super families static_pass; the native comparisons contradict those labels. This is a supplemental cross-review; the consolidated report was not edited.
Unresolved projectile/hit FX are not body sprites and remain unresolved pending separate effect review.
